subject: MAP alignment & sequencing: MSA / DPA / Order Form dependencies (Biotrek)
messages:
From: Amelia D'Souza <amelia@biotrek.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@biotrek.ai
Date: 2027-08-16T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff + target close window (MSA/DPA/Order Form)

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Biotrek's evaluation team is aligned and procurement asked me to pull the MAP (mutual action plan) together so we can lock a target signature date. High level asks from our side:

- Can you confirm dependencies between your standard MSA, DPA, and the order form? Which document needs to be final before we execute the others?
- Any required security artifacts (SOC2 report, DPA appendix) we should include in the MAP?
- Targeting an internal procurement window of Sept 24–30. Is that realistic from Redwood's side?

I've attached a one-pager with our proposed evaluation timeline and acceptance criteria. If we can get a short mutual plan by EOD Tuesday I'd like to send it into our legal and procurement queues.

Thanks,
Amelia D'Souza
Head of Partnerships | Biotrek AI
Amelia D'Souza | amelia@biotrek.ai

Attachments (mentioned): MAP_EvalPlan_Biotrek.xlsx (evaluation milestones, acceptance tests)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Amelia D'Souza <amelia@biotrek.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-16T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + target close window (MSA/DPA/Order Form)

Amelia — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Opening with a short plan so we can get alignment internally and with our legal team. Top-level answers first:

1) Sequencing (recommended):
   - Sign MSA first (commercial framework)
   - Execute DPA in tandem or immediately after MSA with any required appendices
   - Order form executed last (pricing, SKUs, add-ons) — allows us to keep pricing flexible pending final capacity/regions

2) Security artifacts: we will attach our most recent SOC 2 Type II and a standard DPA appendix. If Biotrek requires an additional encryption attestation or bespoke clause, flag it ASAP.

3) Sept 24–30 target: doable if we land on the MAP and your legal submits redlines by Aug 23. Key internal gating items for Redwood: legal review of redlines (48–72h for first pass), finance PO pathing, and a short commercial review for order-form discounts.

Action items I'm proposing for the MAP (we can publish this as a shared doc):
- Aug 18: Mutual Action Plan draft (Redwood assigns legal & finance owners)
- Aug 23: Biotrek returns redlines / security exceptions
- Aug 25: Redwood legal response + expected concession list
- Sept 1: Commercial exec approval on final order form (if concessions > threshold)
- Sept 24–30: Target signature window

I'm attaching our current MSA (Redwood_MSA_v3.pdf) and a draft order form template for you to review. Laura — FYI on the proposed cadence; Karthik / Vanessa please flag any operational blockers (regions, dedicated capacity) with Biotrek's acceptance criteria.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments (mentioned): Redwood_MSA_v3.pdf, Biotrek_OrderForm_Draft.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, Amelia D'Souza <amelia@biotrek.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-17T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + target close window (MSA/DPA/Order Form)

Markus / Amelia — quick operational notes from product/onboarding perspective so the MAP acceptance criteria are practical:

- Eval plan: for Biotrek's acceptance tests, we need a stable model snapshot and a shared test corpus. Suggest we include the following checkpoints in the MAP:
  * Week 1 (eval start): access + baseline perf metrics (latency/throughput)
  * Week 2: KV cache/latency regression check with production-sized prompts
  * Week 3: Security posture sign-off (VPC routing + logs)
  * Final: Acceptance sign-off tied to billing plan and order form items

- Dependencies: If Biotrek requires a private VPC deployment or HSM KMS integration, that will push order-form finalization out by at least 2–3 weeks for provisioning. If they are OK with hosted + dedicated pool, we can keep to the Sept window.

- Request to procurement/legal: please use the DPA appendix we discussed in the last partner deal; that should cut review time if Biotrek's redlines are minor.

Thanks — I'll start building the MAP doc with these checkpoints and share a Drive link.

—Laura
Laura Bennett | Senior Solutions PM, Redwood Inference

From: procurement@biotrek.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: legal@biotrek.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-18T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + target close window (MSA/DPA/Order Form)

Markus / Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the MSA and the draft order form and have two high-level notes before redlines:

1) DPA: our legal asked whether Redwood is open to adding an encryption-at-rest covenant and a limited subprocessors list in the DPA appendix. If you can pre-populate the subprocessors list and confirm encryption controls, that will speed our review.

2) Order Form: procurement is preparing an internal justification to approve the order-form discounts. To align with your cadence, we'll deliver redlines on Aug 23. One ask — can Redwood confirm a hard stop for concessions beyond Sept 8? After that date our finance team cannot accept material changes without re-approvals.

If Redwood can include the SOC2 report and a filled subprocessors appendix in the MAP draft (by Aug 18 end of day), we will prioritize legal review and aim to meet the Sept 24–30 signature window.

Best,
Biotrek Procurement (on behalf of Amelia D'Souza)
procurement@biotrek.ai
